hypothesis: PLAN.md Phase 4 item 1: bounce ONE fixed clipper setting 5 times to measure the honest run-to-run standard deviation of crest, replacing the PROVISIONAL n=2 cross-session estimate of ~0.02 dB (MAP.md, from the Phase 3 values-list demo). 0.766 chosen because it is the known-good midpoint of snts_kick_clip_validate_v1's inverse-table check (target crest 6.0 dB). Same Row-2 rig: StandardCLIP devices[6] ON, all other track-6 effects OFF, set up with 'rig.py solo-device --track 6 --device 6' and torn down with 'rig.py restore'. Every value in the list is identical, so any spread we see is pure bounce-to-bounce noise, not a knob effect. This stddev becomes the --tol for summarize_curve.py and the error bar on every MAP.md crest prediction.
